performance.evidence: Control transitions and draw-command generation are bounded constant-time operations with no I/O, allocation, polling, or retry loop.

reliability.evidence: Focused GTK2, pure-control, and GTK3 tests pass; duplicate releases do not activate twice; full make check and distcheck pass.

operability.evidence: Configure reports whether the GTK3 proof is enabled, --enable requires GTK 3.24, --disable is explicit, and linkage failures produce terminal test failures.
